```{r}
db_table_columns <- db_tables_columns[[db_table$table_gav()]]

db_table_usages <- db_tables_usages[[db_table$table_gav()]]
with_depedencies <- nrow(db_table_dependencies) > 0
with_usages <- nrow(db_table_usages) > 0
```

